after: 针对个人错题分散、解析与后续练习脱节的问题，设计并实现基于智谱 GLM 大模型的 AI 错题分析与学习推荐系统。系统采用 Vue 3、Spring Boot 与 MySQL，组织 AI 辅助错因分析、知识内容复用、持续练习和固定节点复习，提供基于个人题库检索与规则匹配的个性化学习推荐。平台校验并保存模型结果，按角色和数据归属控制访问。工程回归中，后端 109 项通过、4 项联网入口按开关跳过，前端 33 项单元测试与 5 项浏览器端到端流程全部通过。历史真实模型与小样本实验支持所测条件下的功能可用性，也呈现了内容错误及检索增益的边界。系统连接了错题学习与后续练习，生成内容仍需学生核查，长期教学效果有待进一步评价。

before: To connect scattered personal wrong-question records with analysis and follow-up practice, this project designs and implements an AI-powered wrong-question analysis and learning recommendation system based on the Zhipu GLM model. The system uses Vue 3, TypeScript, Spring Boot, MyBatis-Plus and MySQL in a decoupled front-end and back-end architecture. Retrieval from the learner's own question collection supplies model context, and the platform validates and stores auxiliary analyses and practice resources. It reuses valid knowledge content and unpractised questions before generating additional resources, while recording actual attempts, fixed-schedule reviews and rule-based question scores. Students, teachers and administrators access functions according to their roles and data ownership. Engineering tests, previously recorded live model calls and small-sample experiments support functional operation under the tested conditions and show that generated content still requires review. The system connects personal wrong-question study with continued practice. Probabilistic knowledge tracing has not been implemented, and long-term educational effectiveness requires further evaluation.
after: To connect scattered personal error records with analysis and follow-up practice, this project designs and implements an AI-powered error analysis and learning recommendation system based on the Zhipu GLM model. Built with Vue 3, Spring Boot and MySQL, it combines AI-assisted error analysis, reusable knowledge content, continued practice and fixed-schedule reviews. Personalized learning recommendations use retrieval and rule matching within each learner's own question collection. The platform validates and stores model outputs and controls access by role and data ownership. Engineering regression yielded 109 passing back-end tests and four network-dependent entries skipped by configuration; all 33 front-end unit tests and five browser end-to-end workflows passed. Historical live-model tests and small-sample experiments support functional operation under the tested conditions while revealing content errors and limits to retrieval benefits. The system connects error review with further practice. Generated content requires learner verification, and long-term educational effectiveness remains to be evaluated.
